protocol: Preflight-only refusals launch no benchmark command and reveal no performance samples. The sampling plan, candidate, references, seed and decision thresholds remain frozen.
review: Independent benchmark reviewer agreed before any measured child launched.
reservation: The requested window was about 35 minutes, not an absolute timestamp. Each launched job has a 35 minute cancellation deadline; jobs remain serial and the contention guard remains active.
